name: Watanuki Zakuro
source:
A quiet girl.

She spends her time taking care of Akoya, who tends to skip meals whenever he gets absorbed in painting.

She is greatly fond of Akoya's beautiful paintings of her and considers them to be the only thing she needs.

[translated from [url=https://succulent01.wixsite.com/zakurono]official website[/url]]
